sources.use: The engine. Built from this pinned source; reviewed for ideas only, no text copied (copyleft).

build.ocaml_note: the opam file requires >= 5.2.1; the engine's own release scripts and Makefile use 5.5.1; its INSTALL.md says 5.5.0

linux.note: Ubuntu 24.04 ships libpcre2 10.42 and the engine needs >= 10.43; install the engine's libraries without apk --no-cache

sources.use: Adapted into skills/orbyn-opengrep/SKILL.md and references/rule-writing.md with credit; licence kept in references/opengrep-skills-LICENSE.txt.

The official community rules (a fork of Semgrep's rules). Reviewed only: never copied into the library. Its README says research, testing and benchmarking; the Commons Clause forbids selling. A local clone may be used to scan your own code once the maintainer has accepted the licence.
